row.medi_said: ليش، ليش فرق من-- ليش فرق من WhatsApp? ... ليش فرق؟
row.amal_said: كيف؟ ... No because I'm using لأنه عم بستعمل الـ telephone.
row.right: مختلف عن (my reading; or ليش في فرق / شو الفرق)
row.why: فرق is the noun 'difference'; 'why is it different' wants the adjective مختلف (sheet: different (from) | mu5talef | مختلف) or غير (sheet: other/different | 8air | غير) - a different lexical item, so tier 1 not tier 2; she said كيف؟ (did not follow), he re-asked in English and she answered the question without fixing; the من after it is part of the same slip (مختلف عن), see D14.
row.english: Why is it different from WhatsApp?

rulings.why: Both readers have the row; tier differs. فرق -> مختلف swaps the word (noun 'difference' for adjective 'different', different roots), which is the tier-1 definition; tier 2 is for a wrong form of the same word. Let-pass, so vocab-B.
